g.text: A hydraulic jump converts supercritical flow into deeper subcritical flow and dissipates energy
Rectangular horizontal channel, unit discharge2 m²/s, momentum correction≈1, negligible external longitudinal force over the jump. Sequent depths share
momentum, not specific energy. Roller shape/length is qualitative; required tailwater and a stable jump location need additional hydraulic design.
